g000.content: The asteroid collision polygons need to be drawn/created in the viewport (editor), not defined purely in code.
g000.title: Asteroid collision polygons must be drawn in editor

g001.content: Asteroid visual appearance can be decided by the client; collision variant must be handled on the server to remain authoritative.
g001.title: Asteroid appearance client-side, collision server-authoritative

g002.content: Spawn logic must be established before update logic is an issue; spawn first, then update.
g002.title: Spawn before update for game objects

g003.content: Asteroids must spawn off-screen, travel in a randomish direction toward the player, have random size between 1 and 4, and use a random texture with matching collision.
g003.title: Asteroid spawning behavior constraints
